# REVIEW FIX 4.3 — every package is pinned AND hash-locked.
#
# Why this matters beyond pinning: a version number alone trusts whatever
# PyPI serves under that name today. A hash pins the actual bytes, so a
# compromised or re-uploaded artifact fails the install instead of shipping.
# pip switches into hash-checking mode automatically once any requirement
# carries a hash, and the Dockerfiles pass --require-hashes explicitly so the
# protection cannot be lost by someone editing this file back to bare pins.
#
# Transitive dependencies are listed too — that is the point. Previously only
# worker's 4 direct packages were pinned while ~17 transitive ones floated.
#
